About four days. It's been building.
Any swelling on the outside?
Nothing swollen outside. Just this deep pain.
Have you had cavities or fillings before?
My teeth have never been great. Three or four fillings in those back molars.

Indeed, neither hot nor cold changes anything. The pain is there either way.
